title: Transfer of RNA from Acrylamide Gels onto Membranes
author: Jonathan Houseley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bns2mege

steps.title: Prepare Paper and Membrane
steps.instruction: Prepare the blotting materials to the size of the gel (maximum 9 × 9 cm).

substeps.instruction: Cut two pieces of Whatman paper and one piece of membrane to the size of the gel.
Cut a corner of the membrane to track orientation.
Label the membrane with pencil on the same side as the RNA.

steps.title: Assemble Blotting Apparatus
steps.instruction: Assemble the blotting apparatus using 0.5× TBE as transfer buffer according to the manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: Cut off the gel foot before laying the membrane on the gel to avoid bubble formation.

steps.title: Perform RNA Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the RNA from the gel to the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Set the transfer for 02:00:00 at 30 V (note: 01:30:00 may be sufficient).

steps.title: Crosslink RNA to Membrane
steps.instruction: Irradiate the membrane to crosslink the RNA, ensuring the paper and membrane are lightly damp (not dripping or dry).

substeps.instruction: Place the two pieces of Whatman paper and the membrane together on the floor of the cross-linker with the RNA side facing upward.
Irradiate using Auto-crosslink mode for a Stratalinker or 120,000 μJ/cm2 for other cross-linkers.
